snippet.title: CURSE RETOLD - Escape Mode (ACT 1) // Teaser Trailer (Hello Neighbor 1 Mod) // Early Footage
snippet.description:
⚠️ FOOTAGE IS NOT FINAL ⚠️
!! MAJOR IMPROVEMENTS HAVE BEEN MADE POST-TRAILER !!

"Escape Mode" is a lighthearted spin-off gamemode of Curse Retold that takes place between Chapter 1 & 2, in a nightmare Nicky had after witnessing what lies within the undergrounds of the Petersons house.

Put your stealth to the test and help Nicholas face his fears to escape his neighbor's house, so he can also escape his own mind.

Mod Page: https://www.moddb.com/mods/hello-neighbor-curse-retold

----------
